_note: Ambient beds: recorded nature loops, layered per zone by src/engine/audio/ambience.ts. All CC0. Rebuild with: python3 -I tools/sfx/build_ambience.py park=<dir> crickets=<dir> swamp=<dir> loops=<dir>. A bed with no `start` takes the steadiest window of `seconds` in the recording (least loudness variation, no sudden events) so a dog bark or a passing car in a long field recording isn't looped forever.
